title: 16.10 · Один владелец действий · версия58
scope: Single unified scene: one action owner, one goal, one prepared walking route per resident; seat reserved at goal choice and held to the action; residents pass through each other so no mutual detour is produced; an unreachable goal is replaced by another available place instead of a long dead search. Player weapon shop, needs, medical care at 50% health, threat reactions, four destructible homes and ten personal beds kept. Performance acceptance pending.
